title: Walter Page's arrangements and pianist Willie Lewis
summary: Page wrote a few arrangements and played tuba then; the pianist Willie Lewis from Peoria was a great musician who died in a house fire.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: And who was doing those arrangements?
Walter Page wrote a little bit.
He was with the band already then?
Yeah. He was playing strings, the upright bass.
Yes! He had a big upright bass. Let me see... No, he didn't.
Yeah, he had a tuba. Yeah, that's what it was.
Okay. So you had arrangements and Walter Page was doing some. Who was playing piano with the band?
Now, the only Willie Lewis I know is an alto player who went to Europe, but this must be a different one.
No, this here is a different fella. He's from Peoria, Illinois. He was what they call one of those gay fellas, you know. He was a very great musician.
No, he's dead. He got burned up in a house. ....[INAUDIBLE SENTENCE].... in Peoria, they tell me.
